name: Pinterest Tool
description: Find profile icons and banners on Pinterest, then edit them (effects, text, pictures, GIFs) before applying. Adds a Pinterest button to the Select an Image dialog of the profile. The interface is Pinterart by szcx404; the search, storage and secret cookie are written for Amiricord.

credits.name: Vendicated and contributors (Vencord), plugin Pinterest Tool by szcx404
Pinterart interface by szcx404 (also credited as szaleniec1327), derived from Vencord's PinterestSearch

network.why: search and anonymous session; Pinterest sends people to a regional Pinterest site
